notes.title: 20,000 Copies Sold!
notes.content:
Big news, everyone! Thought Experiment Simulator has officially surpassed 20,000 copies sold! A huge thank you to all of you who played, shared, and supported the game—your enthusiasm means the world to me.

To celebrate, we're running another 20% discount on February 16! If you haven't picked up the game yet, now's the perfect time—add it to your wishlist so you don’t miss out!

New Game!
I also want to introduce my new game—Since 1935. This is a narrative-driven experience that tells the story of modern history through the perspective of an ordinary person. I hope it offers a unique take on historical storytelling.
The game is still in development, so if this sounds interesting to you, keep an eye on it—I can’t wait to share more updates with you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3374040/1935/

Check Out the Bundle!
The game is also available in a special bundle with two other amazing games! If you enjoy thought-provoking, unique experiences, you won’t want to miss this deal—check it out on the store page!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45075/Sisyphus_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50413/Maxwells_Thought_Challenge/

What's Next?
I’ve been working hard on porting the game to Nintendo Switch, which is why there haven’t been recent updates on Steam. But don’t worry—a new announcement is coming soon, and I’ll be updating both Steam and Switch versions at the same time!

Once again, thank you for being part of this journey. I can’t wait to share more exciting news with you soon!

notes.title: Cloud Save & Minor Bug Fixes (V1.0.07)
notes.content:
Hi players,

I've updated the game again with some minor fixes, and it's now version 1.0.07.

1. Cloud Save Support: Cloud Save is now available. Although I configured it before the game's launch, Steam's system forces to default it to "dev only" if the game isn't released, and it must be manually changed for public use. I forgot to do this when the game launched, but it’s now enabled.

2. Skippable Narrator Lines: The narrator's "question" lines in the Famous Violinist level are now skippable. I understand many of you replay this level for achievement hunting, and listening to the same questions repeatedly can be annoying. Now, you can skip them.

3. Mac Version Update: The Mac version is now up to date with the Windows version. In the previous update, I mentioned needing to borrow a Mac to export the game, which caused a delay. I've now done that, and the Mac version is current.

Lastly, I'll be adding more good stuff to the game based on player feedback and will likely update the game in a couple of days. Thank you for your support!

Loqi
Creator of Thought Experiment Simulator

notes.title: 発売日の問題の修正 (V1.0.06)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm the creator of this game, and I want to extend my heartfelt thanks for purchasing it. Even though it's just the first day of release, your positive feedback has made me incredibly happy.

I'm pleased to announce that I've addressed two issues in the game and have updated it to Version 1.0.06:

1. Challenge Mode Difficulty: Many players found the Challenge Mode too difficult. To improve this, I've made a couple of adjustments:
Now, when you win a level, you will regain one heart. Previously, you would lose a heart when losing a level and gain nothing upon winning.
The last 6 levels used to be at double speed, which was too challenging for some players. I've now reduced this to only the last 3 levels being at double speed.
Mac version will be updated a few hours later, because I need to borrow a Mac to export the game.

2. "Backstage" Achievement Description: The description for the "Backstage" achievement was somewhat misleading, causing some players to think they needed to buy the OST to unlock it. This is not the case. You can unlock it during the Famous Violinist level. However, if you choose to purchase the OST, it would make me very happy, and all revenue from the OST will go to our composer.

Thank you once again for your support and enjoy the game!

Best regards,
Loqi
Creator of Thought Experiment Simulator
